name: random-letter-swap-forward
title: Random Letter Swap Forward
description: Letters swap out in a random order, each sliding out as an identical copy rolls in, and the wave repeats forward.
useWhen: A word needs a lively letter-by-letter roll that ends exactly where it began, like a hover state on a button or link.
The letters should swap in a random order.
avoidWhen: The letters should turn into different letters or words: use text-rotate, type-fossil or kinetic-type-swap.
A one-time entrance is enough: use per-character-rise or vertical-cut-reveal.
author: Daniel Petho

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word or short phrase whose letters swap.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Reverse
variables.description: On: letters leave downward and the copy arrives from above. Off: the other way round.

variables.label: Spring duration
variables.description: Perceived duration of each letter's spring.

variables.label: Bounce
variables.description: Spring bounce: 0 settles smoothly, higher overshoots.

variables.label: Swaps
variables.description: How many times the wave plays.

variables.label: Interval
variables.description: Seconds from the start of one wave to the next.
